treatments.name: Dental Consultation & Check-up
treatments.price_notes: Includes an examination and treatment advice. X-rays, if needed, are charged separately.
treatments.description: A full examination of your teeth and gums, with a clear explanation of what treatment (if any) you need.

treatments.name: Scaling & Polishing (Teeth Cleaning)
treatments.price_notes: The price depends on how much tartar needs to be removed.
treatments.description: Professional removal of plaque and tartar, followed by polishing to leave your teeth smooth and fresh.

treatments.name: Tooth Filling (Tooth-coloured Composite)
treatments.price_notes: The price depends on the size and position of the cavity.
treatments.description: Removal of decay and restoration of the tooth with a tooth-coloured filling material.

treatments.name: Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
treatments.price_notes: Front teeth are at the lower end of the range and back teeth cost more. A crown, if advised, is charged separately.
treatments.duration: 1 to 3 visits of 45 to 60 minutes each
treatments.description: Treatment that cleans the infected inside of a tooth and seals it, so the tooth can be saved instead of removed. It is done under local anaesthesia.

treatments.name: Dental Crown (Cap)
treatments.price_notes: The price depends on the crown material.
treatments.description: A cap placed over a damaged or weak tooth to restore its shape, strength and appearance.

treatments.name: Tooth Extraction
treatments.price_notes: The price depends on how difficult the extraction is. The dentist confirms this after an X-ray.
treatments.description: Gentle removal of a tooth that cannot be saved, or of a wisdom tooth that is causing problems, under local anaesthesia.

treatments.name: Teeth Whitening
treatments.price_notes: A check-up is done first to make sure whitening is suitable for you.
treatments.description: Professional whitening that lightens stains from tea, coffee and ageing, done under the dentist's supervision.

treatments.name: Braces (Orthodontic Treatment)
treatments.price_notes: The final cost depends on the complexity of your case and the type of braces.
treatments.duration: usually 12 to 24 months, with a visit about once a month
treatments.description: Orthodontic treatment that gradually straightens crooked teeth and corrects bite problems.

treatments.name: Clear Aligners
treatments.price_notes: The final cost depends on how many aligner sets your case needs.
treatments.description: Nearly invisible, removable trays that gradually move your teeth into position.

treatments.name: Dental Implants
treatments.price_notes: This covers the implant itself. The crown that goes on top is charged separately.
treatments.duration: 2 to 4 visits spread over 3 to 6 months
treatments.description: A titanium post placed in the jaw to replace a missing tooth root, topped with a crown.

treatments.name: Dentures (Removable Teeth)
treatments.price_notes: The price depends on the material and the number of teeth being replaced.
treatments.description: Removable replacement teeth, made to fit your mouth comfortably.

treatments.name: Children's Dentistry
treatments.price_unit: per visit (check-up, cleaning or fluoride application)
treatments.price_notes: Fillings and other treatments for children are priced separately.
treatments.description: Friendly, gentle dental care for children, including check-ups, cleaning, fluoride application and preventive advice.

treatments.name: Dental X-ray
treatments.price_notes: The dentist decides which X-ray you need.
treatments.description: A quick digital X-ray that helps the dentist see what is happening under the surface of your teeth.
